text: Minutes Senior Citizens Commission Meeting Tuesday, March 17, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. City Council Chambers 1. 1.1 1.2 • Present: Claudette Begin, Lawrence Gissible, Lillian Martinez, Thu Thai, Teresita Zurbano • Absent: 2. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – January 20, 2026 2.1 Commissioner Begin made a motion to approve January 20, 2026, minutes as submitted, Vice Chair Zurbano seconded the motion. All approved. 3. • Former Senior Citizens Commissioner Mila Josue spoke briefly regarding the TCV Food Bank program and anyone looking for applications can contact her. 4. • None 5. 5.1 Community and Recreation Services Report • Recreation Supervisor Vera-Lopez gave a report on the activities and classes that have happened since January 2026 including the Lunar New Year Event, Black History Month Showcase and the Superhero 5K Fun Run and Walk; upcoming events include Culture Fest, Annual Spring Egg Hunt and the Annual Cornhole Tournament. 5.2 BART Mural Project Update • Recreation Supervisor Vera-Lopez updated the commission on the status of the BART Mural Project; all five themes (Decoto’s Cultural Heritage, Agricultural and Labor History, Cultural Pride, Youth and Future Generations and Community Strength and Belonging) were shared with the BART Arts Program and approved on March 6, 2026, with the top three being Honor and Visibility for Decoto’s Legacy, Agricultural and Labor Heritage, and Community Resilience and Belonging. 5.3 Parks and Recreation Master Plan Update • Recreation Supervisor Vera-Lopez updated the commission on the status of the Parks and Recreation Master Plan; there are currently a series of workshops and pop-up events planned throughout March, and a community survey is available online through March 31. 6.

6.1 Richard Martinez, Emergency Services coordinator • Emergency Services Coordinator Richard Martinez gave a city preparedness update on behalf of the UCOES (Union City Office of Emergency Services; topics discussed included background on CERT (Community Emergency Response Team) and their mission and PPRR (Prevention, Preparedness, Response, Recovery) Trainings, which provides basic life saving skills and workshops to plan for disasters. 6.2 Lisa Chen, On Lok / Pace • Lisa Chen, Enrollment and Outreach Representative from On Lok/Pace, gave a brief presentation on On Lok/Pace’s mission, the various services that are offered, information on who can enroll, enrollment procedures and how to refer potential participants. 6.3 Annual Filing Requirement – Form 700 • Recreation Supervisor Vera-Lopez reminded the commission that their Statement of Economic Interests – Form 700 is due the beginning of April; all commissioners confirmed their compliance. 6.4 Senior Citizens Commission Signature Event – Saturday, September 12, 2026, at KYC • Sheryl Marymount, Musical Memories Foundation, and Alt-Commissioner Dean Nissen gave a brief update on the status of the signature event; a 17-piece has been booked for the event, and they have reached out to James Logan High School and are awaiting a response. 6.5 Future Goals Committee • Nothing to report 6.6 Ruggieri Center Senior Commission Feedback & Suggestions • Alt-Commissioner Nissen complimented the Ruggieri Center programs, staff and members. 7. • Nothing to report. 8. • Nothing to report. 9. • Nothing to report • Chairperson Gissible adjourned the meeting at 3:47 pm; Commissioner Zurbano seconded the motion; all approved. The next meeting will take place on Tuesday, May 19, 2026.
